optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Process Data Analyst, Steel Rolling Mill

professionalSummary.text: Process data analyst at a steel rolling mill for three years, building and maintaining process monitoring dashboards from sensor and quality laboratory data for two rolling lines.
professionalSummary.witness: Process data analyst at a steel rolling mill for three years, building and maintaining the process monitoring dashboards from the mill's sensor and quality laboratory data for the two rolling lines.

experienceHighlights.text: Investigated out-of-specification events with mill engineers under the investigation procedure, with thirty-one investigations recorded in the investigation register where findings were accepted by mill engineers and corrective actions taken.
experienceHighlights.witness: Investigated the out-of-specification events with the mill engineers under the investigation procedure; the investigation register records thirty-one investigations with my findings accepted by the mill engineers and the corrective actions they took.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared weekly process reviews for the mill manager, with reviews filed in the process data folder.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the weekly process review for the mill manager, with the reviews filed in the process data folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Supported process change trials with trial analyses, with change approvals held by the mill manager and responsibility boundaries recorded on trial records.
experienceHighlights.witness: Supported the process change trials with the trial analyses; the change approvals were the mill manager's, recorded on each trial record together with which analyses were mine and which the automation team's.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented limitation sections and hand-over conditions for each investigation and trial analysis.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each investigation and each trial analysis.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample includes one dashboard specification, investigation register extract for one quarter with accepted findings, weekly process review, and trial record with approval, all with process data folder references as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one dashboard specification, the investigation register extract for one quarter with the accepted findings, one weekly process review and one trial record with its approval, with the process data folder references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Ability to build and maintain process monitoring dashboards from sensor and quality data.
skills.witness: Process data analyst at a steel rolling mill for three years, building and maintaining the process monitoring dashboards from the mill's sensor and quality laboratory data for the two rolling lines.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in building dashboards, investigating out-of-spec events, preparing weekly reviews, supporting trials, and documenting limitations. The materials do not establish whether the candidate explained findings to skeptical mill engineers or how they handled skepticism.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to unverified claims about explaining findings to skeptical engineers and lack of evidence on handling skepticism.
